generate_gmock_from_header: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file containing virtual methods
generate_gmock_for_class: generate Google Mock class for a specific C++ class from a header file
generate_gmock_all_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all virtual classes in a C++ header file
generate_gmock_with_template: generate Google Mock classes for templated C++ classes with virtual methods
generate_gmock_const_methods: generate Google Mock classes preserving const qualifier on virtual methods
